title: Landowner CRM — record schemas
description: Field shapes for every record type in the CRM. Note: numeric-looking fields (value, asking, acres, pct) are stored as STRINGS as entered; the UI parses them when needed. Dates are local 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings.

id.description: Stable unique id. One backend row/document per customer, keyed by this.

name.description: Owner / interest holder. The only required field.

email.description: Used as the recipient for follow-up emails; often empty for owners sourced from courthouse/pooling data.

value.description: Estimated value in dollars, digits only (e.g. "240000").

asking.description: Asking price in dollars, digits only.

tags.description: Free-form labels. Buy signals import as '🔥 <signal>'.

followUp.description: YYYY-MM-DD; next follow-up/callback date. Empty = none. Drives the Call Queue.

interests.description: Mineral/working-interest holdings (an owner can hold several).

documents.description: Pointers to attached files (the files themselves live in object/blob storage).

valuable.description: Marked valuable -> an email follow-up sequence is active.

seqStep.description: Index of the next email step to send.

Interest.description: One mineral/royalty/working-interest holding. Maps 1:1 to a row of source data (Case ID / Well / Interest Type / % Ownership / Buy Signal / Source PDF / exhibit).

foundIn.description: Exhibit the owner was found in.

follow.description: YYYY-MM-DD follow-up set by this call (mirrors customer.followUp).

via.description: auto = sent via webhook; manual = drafted/copied.

Document.description: Pointer to an attached file. The bytes live in blob/object storage; this record just references them.

id.description: Storage key/asset id. In the shipped app the file serves at '/_blob/' + id.

Settings.description: App-wide settings. In cloud mode stored as the single document 'meta/app'.

knownTags.description: Tags created but not yet on any customer.

tagColors.description: Map of tag name -> color index 0..8.

webhook.description: If set, each due email is POSTed here as JSON {to, from, subject, body, name, customerId, step}.

steps.description: The cadence. Merge fields in subject/body: {{name}} {{firstName}} {{county}} {{well}} {{from}} {{sig}}.

day.description: Days after the customer is marked valuable (0 = immediately).
